description: Get current open insider positions for a CIK (either an insider or an issuer). If an issuer (company) CIK is supplied, returns all insiders' positions for that company. If an insider (reporting-person) CIK is supplied, returns that insider's open positions across all issuers they have filed Form 4 for. The response includes a `lookupMode` field (`"issuer"` or `"insider"`) indicating which interpretation matched. Derived from Form 4 filings.

cik.description: SEC CIK number of the insider OR the issuer (company). Tried as issuer first, then falls back to insider.

name: get_insider_positions
title: Get Insider Positions
